title: Trees thin toward a river, driftwood on its bank

checks.description: The river output is a polyline that crosses at least 80% of the ground's extent along one axis.

Trees per unit area, over four equal-area bands of distance from the TRUE river polyline (the planted region: ground footprint clipped to the trees' extent, from the nearest tree's distance outward), rise away from the water: the nearest band is non-empty, the farthest holds at least 1.25x its density, and no band falls below 0.85x the band nearer the water.
Mean tree scale over the same bands rises away from the water: farthest at least 1.3x nearest, no band below 0.95x the band nearer the water.
No tree stands within 2 m of the river line (the water the contract states).
At least 10 pieces of driftwood, and at least 90% of them lie 1-8 m from the river line.
Driftwood within 25 m of the river line reaches at least 8 of 10 equal stretches of the river's length over the ground.
